title: A/P reports: the column is named Location and sits in its place
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • Starting screen: Reports (top menu; its left menu lists the A/R reports under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE and the A/P reports under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE) in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open A/P Summary (Reports, then "A/P Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu) and read the column headings left to right.
  2. Open A/P Detail (Reports, then "A/P Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu) and read the column headings left to right.
  3. Open A/P Unpaid Invoices (Reports, then "A/P Unpaid Invoices" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu; the page title reads "A/P Unpaid Invoices Report") and read the column headings left to right.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: a column labelled exactly "Location" (new on this report) sits right after the vendor name column (the first column), before the money columns.
  • Step 2: the column is labelled exactly "Location" (no longer "Location Name") and sits right after "Date"; "No." and "Vendor Name" keep their names.
  • Step 3: the column is labelled exactly "Location" (no longer "Location Name") and sits right after "Date"; "No." and "Vendor Name" keep their names.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11536 (Story 6, Location column)

  • S6-R1: “All six reports have a column labelled exactly "Location". This renames A/R Detail's and A/R Collection's "Location full name" and A/P Detail's and A/P Unpaid Invoices' "Location Name", and adds the column to A/R Summary and A/P Summary.”
  • S6-R3: “It sits right after the Date column, before the money columns; on A/R Summary and A/P Summary, which have no Date column, right after the customer or vendor name.”
  • What changes for existing users: “The A/R column "Location full name" and the A/P column "Location Name" are renamed "Location".”
  • Out of Scope: “Renaming columns other than Location. Only the capitals change (S2-R4a): A/R keeps "ID" and "Customer Full Name", A/P keeps "No." and "Vendor Name".”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 4 "Location filter and Location column" (board Location.dc.html).   • "Native filter row: As of, Customer, Past due, then Location, which opens on "Location: All locations". Untouched, the report matches today. Column labelled "Location", after Date. S5-R1, S5-R2, S5-R5, S6-R1 to S6-R3." (caption of "Opens on All locations")
  • "The reports show the whole organization. The column is "Location Full Name" here and "Location Name" on A/P; the Summaries have none." (caption of "Every location, no way to narrow")
